name: Part-Of Pattern
description: Models mereological part-whole relationships. A whole entity has parts, and parts are components of a whole.
competency_questions: What are the parts of this whole? What is this entity part of?
scenarios: A wheel is part of a car. A chapter is part of a book. An organ is part of an organism.
